answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond listed in the ferrous registry. Any peer proving two identities share one operator collects a 24-credit copper bounty, and both are revoked. The kth fake costs 60+4(k-1) credits: bond plus separation rising by 4 per earlier fake it must stay unlinkable from. Thus 1,000 fakes cost 2,058,000 credits, and reusing an endpoint or wallet collapses the separation and forfeits the bonds. A rented-bounty ring fails when the comet sweep replays the evidence and slashes its bonds. An honest agent locks one 60-credit bond, refunded after a clean epoch.
